title: Sling: run-up and before take-off
briefing: Engine idling and warm, brakes on, heading into wind. Do the engine check: oil 50 C or more, then lane check at 4,000 rpm (lane B off: no drop; lane A off: under 180 rpm), each fuel pump alone, backup battery, controls full and free, trim neutral, full power check. Then the before-take-off list. If any check fails, stop.
